evidence.sentence: After a careful process involving analysis and consultation across the United States federal government and with leaders in state, local, and tribal governments, the United States is setting an economy-wide target of reducing its net greenhouse gas emissions by 50-52 percent below 2005 levels in 2030.

NATIONALLY DETERMINED CONTRIBUTION The nationally determined contribution of the United States of America is: To achieve an economy-wide target of reducing its net greenhouse gas emissions by 50-52 percent below 2005 levels in 2030.

Scope and coverage: Single-year target a Economy-wide target of reducing net greenhouse gas emissions by 50-52 percent below 2005 levels in 2030 General description of the target; 1 As described in Section 5, progress towards the implementation and of the NDC will be tracked using annual net GHG emissions for 2021 through 2030, compared with net greenhouse gas emissions for 2005.

series.$note: series.observed holds several sources and must not be read as one curve. DS-35: All greenhouse gases including land-use change, GWP100 (OWID, from Climate Watch / PIK), from 1990. DS-02: Asset-level observed emissions, CO₂e GWP100 (Climate TRACE); land use accounted differently from OWID, 2015-2025. DS-40: Total GHG emissions including LULUCF/LUCF exactly as the Party submitted them to the UNFCCC, on that Party’s own reporting guidelines and GWP set (UNFCCC Data Interface, snapshot of 2024-07-05). Non-Annex I Parties report only the years their national communications cover, and the figure is negative where reported removals exceed reported emissions. Points from an NDC document are that document's own inventory basis. The same year can appear more than once with different values; R3 keeps them side by side and never averages them.

verdict.text: United States withdrew from the Paris Agreement, with effect from 2026-01-27 (UN Treaty Collection, XXVII-7-d). Its withdrawal from the UNFCCC takes effect on 2027-02-27 (XXVII-7). United States' First NDC (2021) states a reduction of 50 to 52% by 2030 against 2005 baseline (condition not read). The UNFCCC registry holds no active NDC for this Party: the registry lists 3 submission(s) for this Party and none of them is active. 78 observed values are loaded from DS-02 (11), DS-35 (35), DS-40 (32). For 2024 the sources disagree: DS-02 6613.4 MtCO₂e, DS-35 6054.3 MtCO₂e. They are on different inventory scopes and the engine does not reconcile them. No implementation gap is reported: the pledge is a range, 50 to 52% below 2005 levels by 2030, and no single figure is taken from it, so no target tonnage is derived and the trend is not judged against it. It submitted BTR1. 3 of 8 components have been confirmed in the document; the rest are unparsed, which is not a finding against the country. ND-GAIN scores it 65.7 for 2024. In the first NDC round, WRI's CAIT assessment recorded: 26% to 28% reduction in GHG emission by 2025 compared to 2005 and to make best efforts to reduce its emissions by 28% It was classed unconditional. That is a 2016 assessment of an earlier submission, not the target above. Projected warming for 2080-2099 against 1995-2014 ranges from +1.6°C under SSP1-2.6 to +5.38°C under SSP5-8.5. These are model runs, not observations.
